abstract: Vaginal dermoid cyst is a rare finding. Preoperative diagnosis of this lesion is difficult as the sonographic features are similar to those of an epidermal inclusion cyst. We report a case of vaginal dermoid cyst and present its sonographic characteristics.
abstract_ja: 膣類皮嚢腫は稀な所見である。類皮嚢腫の術前診断は困難であり、超音波所見が表皮封入嚢腫と類似している。本稿では膣類皮嚢腫の1例を報告し、その超音波所見を示す。
